final:
**Task complete.** 

The bug was a greedy regex quantifier. The original `.+` matched as much as possible, so in `[a] and [b]` it captured everything from the first `[` to the last `]` as a single item: `a] and [b`.

Changed to `.+?` (non-greedy) so it matches the shortest string between brackets. Now it correctly extracts multiple tags from a single string. All tests pass.
